title: An etale neighbourhood of a strictly henselian closed point has a section
statement: Let R be a commutative strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], U a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], f:U→Spec R etale [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and y∈U with f(y) the closed point. There exists sigma:Spec R→U with sigma;f=id.

source.place: exists_section_of_etale_of_isStrictlyHenselianLocalRing, lines 65-108; strictly henselian etale-neighbourhood section used in Stacks Tag 0EYG

proof.text: Take an affine open containing y, with coordinate ring B and prime n corresponding to y. The etale map R→B makes B_n weakly etale over R. Its structure map is local since n contracts to the maximal ideal. A local weakly etale algebra over a strictly henselian local ring has bijective structure map; invert it to define Spec R→Spec B_n, then compose with Spec B_n→Spec B→U. Naturality of Spec and the inverse equation give the section identity. This is already proved in the source library, whose declaration is used unchanged.
